TASK: Implement the native rorca contract in /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite. This is an executable assignment, not a context handoff.

DELIVERABLE: Working uncommitted native code plus RED and GREEN evidence for rorca identity, Ghostty preference import, safe project registration, and branch-list IPC. Return exact test commands/results, touched files, and residual limitations.

SCOPE: You exclusively own src-tauri/**. Do not modify ui/**, docs, .omo/**, or generated image source. Existing generated icons in src-tauri/icons are already present; you may wire Tauri config to them. Do not commit, stash, reset, checkout, or revert other work.

READ FIRST: .omo/plans/rorca-ui-parity.md, ORCA_LITE_PARITY_AUDIT.md, ORCA_LITE_PARITY_FIX_EXECUTION.md, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, src-tauri/src/lib.rs, the existing IPC/worktree/terminal modules and integration tests.

REQUIREMENTS:
1. Native identity: change product/window identity to rorca (not legacy Orca Lite) and use the generated icons. Preserve package/bundle compatibility only where required; report any identifier decision with rationale.
2. Ghostty contract (TDD): create focused tests FIRST that fail for (a) repeated font-family is last-wins; observed config has MesloLGS NF then Noto Sans KR, so Noto Sans KR is effective, (b) macos-option-as-alt=true is parsed, (c) absent/malformed config returns safe defaults. Implement a typed, non-executing parser for this supported subset. Expose a camelCase terminal-preferences DTO/IPC command for the UI. Config lookup may use standard Ghostty macOS locations, but must be deterministic and independently testable from an injected path/string.
3. Project add/branch selector contract (TDD): the UI needs a safe typed command to register/add a local Git project into WorkspaceRegistry by canonicalizing its repo root and a typed command returning real local branches for the selected workspace. Validate paths/allowed roots using the existing IPC security patterns; never trust raw paths for Git operations. Add integration coverage for valid repo, invalid/non-git path, and branch list.
4. Preserve every completed D1-D11 terminal/worktree safety invariant and camelCase structured errors.

VERIFY: Capture each RED before the corresponding production implementation, then GREEN using cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml. Run cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings after all native changes. Use LSP diagnostics on changed Rust files. Do not suppress any warning/error.

STOP WHEN: All four native requirements are implemented with RED->GREEN evidence, Rust tests+clippy pass, LSP errors are absent, and your summary names the exact UI IPC contract the frontend lane must consume.
